E0103

`print` needs at least one thing to print

What

`print` needs at least one thing to print

Why

Printing nothing isn't meaningful

Fix

e.g. print("hello")

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0103: tests/ui/game_replay_wrong_artifact_e0103.stderr.

Error [E0103]: `Replay.record` needs a `.jetreplay` game replay path
  --> tests/ui/game_replay_wrong_artifact_e0103.jet:4:34
    |
  4 |     replay :: game.Replay.record("run.jetproof-replay")
    |                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: that suffix identifies a proof replay, not a game input replay
 Fix: rename the path to end in `.jetreplay`
